description: Rewrite the Supabase Edge Function (supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts) to support RAG, tool calling, streaming (SSE), rate limiting, and provider fallback. Also update the frontend AI provider service and create streaming.ts.
steps: Completely rewrite supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts: Accept { message, agentType, conversationId?, enableRag?, enableTools? }. Flow: validate JWT, rate limit (30 req/min per user), determine agent, if enableRag query knowledge_base + build DB context, build enhanced prompt, call AI with OpenAI function calling (define all 10 tools as function schemas), handle tool_calls loop, save conversation + tokens, support SSE streaming via Accept: text/event-stream header, provider fallback OpenAI->Gemini->Anthropic
Update src/services/ai/providers.ts: ProxyProvider.chat sends enableRag: true and enableTools: true. Add streaming support method to ProxyProvider.

Create src/services/ai/streaming.ts: streamChat function that connects via fetch ReadableStream to Edge Function SSE endpoint, handles onChunk/onToolCall/onComplete callbacks, graceful fallback to non-streaming on error
acceptance_criteria: Edge Function handles enableRag and enableTools parameters
Edge Function defines all 10 OpenAI function schemas for tool calling
Edge Function supports SSE streaming when Accept: text/event-stream header is present
Edge Function implements rate limiting (30 req/min per user)
Edge Function has provider fallback chain: OpenAI -> Gemini -> Anthropic
ProxyProvider sends RAG/tools flags in requests
streaming.ts provides streamChat with progressive rendering callbacks
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
